name: std::to_string
intro:
Returns a string with a description of f.

The standard recommends that the description should provide information about the contained evaluation, including information from f.source_file() and f.source_line().

sections.title: Parameters
sections.text:
f

 -

  a stacktrace_entry whose description is to be returned

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: A string with a description of f.

sections.title: Notes
sections.text: Custom allocators support for this function is not provided, because the implementations usually require platform specific allocations, system calls and a lot of CPU intensive work, while a custom allocator does not provide benefits for this function as the platform specific operations take an order of magnitude more time than the allocation.

examples.output:
Description of an empty stacktrace entry:
 
Description of a non-empty stacktrace entry:
0x0000000000402DE9 in ./prog.exe

summary: Returns a string with a description of f.
